    ProblemDetail:

        id:
          title: ID

          format: int32

          example: 1
          readOnly: true

          title: Name

          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. It
            must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'; the stored and returned value is
            that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased. A
            present-but-invalid value is rejected with a 400.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present, the owner's 'ageBand' is derived from it,
            computed against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            An optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the
            owner's city region using the fixed table (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true on create, allows an owner that shares a household with an
            existing owner — same last name (compared case-insensitively with
            collapsed whitespace) and same postcode — to be created as a declared
            household member instead of being rejected with a 409. A declared member
            is not flagged as a possible duplicate. It does not create the household
            link: the householdId is deterministic, so co-resident owners share it
            automatically.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes from the left (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region for the owner, read from the region segment of the
                customerCode (the part before the '-'), or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode
                maps to no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is
                the region code derived from the owner's postcode (NSW 2000-2099,
                VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099, else 'UNKNOWN') and HASH8 is the first 8
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the last name. There are no sequence numbers.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable, deterministic identifier for the household: the first 12 hex
                characters of SHA-256 over 'normalizedLastName|postcode', where the last
                name is compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace. Every owner
                carries one, so owners with the same last name and postcode share it
                automatically.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                A derived key formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId', where email
                is empty when absent and householdId is the owner's deterministic household id.
                A create is rejected with a 409 when its whole identityKey equals an existing
                owner's (the same person), or when it shares an existing owner's household
                (same last name and postcode) unless it sets 'sharesHousehold'.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the time this owner was created,
                that share the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, computed on creation. Starts
                at 1, gains 1 when an email address is present, and gains 1 when the
                owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), capped at 3. Level 4 is
                reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel. 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate when present and
                computed against the registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18,
                'ADULT' for 18-64, and 'SENIOR' for 65 and over. Absent when no
                birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk sign-up warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's
                registrationDate at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, it was not a hard
                duplicate but shared an existing owner's lastName and postcode while
                carrying a different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same
                lastName and postcode, different telephone), set only when
                possibleDuplicate is true; otherwise absent.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I implemented the tenure-based membership level 4 rule.

**Change** — `src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`: replaced the inline `membershipLevel` expression (which hard-capped at 3 and never reached 4) with a `membershipLevel(Owner)` helper method:

```java
default int membershipLevel(Owner owner) {
    int base = Math.min(3, 1
            + (hasEmail(owner) ? 1 : 0)
            + (owner.getNamesakeCount() != null && owner.getNamesakeCount() == 0 ? 1 : 0));
    long tenureDays = owner.getRegistrationDate() == null ? 0
            : java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(
                    owner.getRegistrationDate(), java.time.LocalDate.now());
    return base + (tenureDays > 365 ? 1 : 0);
}
```

The pre-tenure factors (base 1, +1 email, +1 no-namesake) stay capped at 3; level 4 is awarded only when tenure exceeds 365 days. Since a newly created owner's `registrationDate` is stamped to today, its tenure is 0 (≤365), so it can never exceed level 3 — a new owner with an email and `namesakeCount` 0 lands at exactly 3.

**Doc** — `src/main/resources/openapi.yml`: bumped `membershipLevel`'s `maximum` from 3 to 4 and updated the description to state the tenure-over-365-days rule for level 4.

**Tests**: `AcceptanceTest.coreNewOwnerCappedAtLevel3` and the full suite pass (`BUILD SUCCESS`).
